title: FlowDoc Product Domain Relationship
summary: Record a bounded product-domain relationship map that names FlowDoc product domains, their high-level dependencies, and the follow-up domain documents future rooms must read before detailed design or implementation.
expectedOutput: FlowDoc Product Domain Relationship v0 in Project Control as a domain-level relationship map and reading router, with major product domains listed, high-level domain dependencies captured, follow-up domain documents named, and detailed schema work intentionally deferred to narrower domain documents.
riskSummary: The product-domain relationship map may be mistaken for a full database schema, implementation contract, or product readiness evidence. The record explicitly says it is not a full database schema, keeps it bounded as a reading router, and states that internal ERD or hierarchical relationship models belong in follow-up domain documents.
